experiment: A5 Attention first-call split autotune per shape (on top of A3)
mechanism: first eager call per launch shape (never under capture): n_splits x{0.5,0.75,1.25,1.5,2} capped at tiles (flat: B*tiles), coop toggle only when all CTAs resident; interleaved cold-L2 graph timing; incumbent unless >=3% faster than the better of two incumbent timings and rel-L2 < 1e-2 vs incumbent output
safety: qkv is const in the kernel; K/V cache writes are idempotent; workspaces persistent per signature; tuning skipped under stream capture
affected_rule: benchmark shapes whose key is AT ... SELECT in the log
retention: selected shapes normalized >= 1.03 vs reference profile AND not below A3 (8347b4ca3b1e42e5) on the same shapes; any retention needs a confirming run; measurement value otherwise
